title: MoSAIK: Motion Search with Artificial Intelligence in K-space
abstract: arXiv:2610.27156v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Object:   Motion artefacts remain a major limitation of routine two-dimensional T2-weighted turbo spin-echo (TSE) brain MRI, reducing diagnostic confidence and often necessitating repeated acquisitions. MoSAIK (Motion Search with AI in K-space) retrospectively estimates in-plane rigid-body motion directly from standard multi-coil TSE k-space. Without a motion-free reference, external navigators, or additional acquisitions, MoSAIK infers motion from k-space self-consistency violations and incorporates predicted parameters into model-based, motion-aware reconstruction rather than synthesizing corrected images.   Materials and Methods:   Selected complex coil data were represented as log-magnitude and phase channels. A decoupled convolutional embedding and Transformer encoder estimated phase-encoding-line-indexed rotation and two-dimensional translations. Training used motion-free clinical acquisitions with simulated motion; four held-out s

translated_title: MoSAIK：基于人工智能的K空间运动搜索
translated_abstract: 目的：运动伪影仍然是常规二维T2加权快速自旋回波（TSE）脑部MRI的主要限制因素，其降低了诊断置信度，且经常需要重复采集。MoSAIK（基于人工智能的K空间运动搜索）可直接从标准多线圈TSE k空间数据中回顾性地估计平面内刚体运动。在无需无运动参考图像、外部导航器或额外采集的情况下，MoSAIK通过k空间自洽性破坏来推断运动，并将预测的参数纳入基于模型的运动感知重建中，而非合成校正后的图像。材料与方法：选取的复数线圈数据被表示为对数幅值和相位通道。采用解耦的卷积嵌入和Transformer编码器来估计以相位编码行索引的旋转和二维平移。训练采用带有模拟运动的无运动临床采集数据；四个留出样本（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: MoSAIK提出了一种无需无运动参考、外部导航器或额外采集，直接从多线圈TSE k空间数据中利用卷积嵌入与Transformer编码器估计脑部MRI平面内刚体运动，并将运动参数纳入基于模型的运动感知重建的创新方法。
